headline: Nearly 39,000 Businesses Leave the HCMC Market: Why Is It Easy to Set Up but Hard to Operate?
summary: Setting up a business in Ho Chi Minh City has become easier, but firms still face many procedural hurdles to operate. Experts propose linking procedures and sharing data across agencies.
why: Business formation and exit rates are a key indicator of the local operating environment, affecting investment decisions in Vietnam's largest commercial hub.
